activities.title: Bring the Lab 3 chart into a slide
activities.intro: Watch the demo of copying the Lab 3 chart from Excel into PowerPoint. Follow the steps, then answer from the chart on the screen.

items: In Excel, click the chart's edge and press Ctrl + C.
In PowerPoint, go to your chart slide and press Ctrl + V.
Click the Paste Options icon: keep it embedded (editable) or paste as a Picture (fixed).
Rewrite the chart title as a message.

blocks.prompt: Bond paper, long (₱7,950) plus bond paper, A4 (₱6,125) is how much?
About what percent of the ₱22,039.00 total is bond paper?
Which Paste Option makes the chart match the slide colours?
You will send the file to others. Which paste is safest?

help: Google Slides: Insert › Chart › From Sheets. It stays linked; click Update when the data changes.
Impress: copy the chart from Calc and paste it.
No chart? Use Insert › Chart in PowerPoint and type the numbers.

activities.title: Put your Lab 3 chart (or Lab 1 image) on a slide
activities.intro: This step completes one of the Lab 4 graded requirements. Work in your Lab 4 file, slide 4. Tick each step as you finish it.

items: Open your Lab 3 file, copy the chart (Ctrl + C).
In Lab 4, go to your chart slide and paste (Ctrl + V). No chart? Insert your Lab 1 image.
Resize from a corner so it fills the content area, not the whole slide.
Change the slide title to a message, e.g. "Bond paper is 64% of our supplies cost".
Add alt text: right-click › View Alt Text.

blocks.prompt: Which handle do you drag to resize without stretching?
Which chart slide title states a message?
options: Bond paper is 64% of our supplies cost

blocks.prompt: In PowerPoint, where do you add alt text?
Optional: a screenshot of your chart slide

help: Chart pasted huge? Resize it from a corner.
Colours changed? That's "Use Destination Theme", which is fine.
Google Slides: the chart must be in Google Sheets first.
Pie chart? The message title still works: "Bond paper takes the biggest slice."
